objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (Level 1–4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation included in the document name (e.g. RL for guideline).

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow or lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document version remains valid.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Time period for validity extension check (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications attribute.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity for the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope metadata printed via TAG technology.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language version of the document.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: In a multi-client system, specifies in which clients the document is visible.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document; subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment within the release process.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A non-controlled document supplement not subject to the release cycle of the main document; released directly via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal to amend a released document, created by any author and tracked until completion.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, processed via workflow.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate (put out of force) a released document and archive it.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated/archived document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document management processes in various roles.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System/license role assigned to the user (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used for authorization and distribution assignment.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list maintained per document specifying user groups and persons to be notified or asked for acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance that routes tasks through steps such as Creator, Review and Release.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants to confirm completion of a workflow step.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity (department, location) to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents via the filing structure.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific view providing document lists and evaluations to users.

objs.name: report
objs.description: A role-specific evaluation report with selection parameters for filtering documents and related information.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Type of report (e.g. Status report, Search for documents, Status report for acknowledgement).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with a selected document type.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type selected upon creation.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or changed via the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator–Review–Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step (Creator).

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assigned reviewers check the document for technical and formal correctness.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Assigned releasers approve the document for publication.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the approval workflow, canceling subsequent tasks.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content or attribute changes.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is changed, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the next release of the main document.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: Non-controlled additional information is added to a document.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Additional information is removed from a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for a released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is planned for implementation, triggering a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the completion of a change proposal.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: A releaser (or author/reviewer/releaser) confirms the continued validity of a document, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically generates a request for validity extension 30 days before expiry.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: The document is declared out of force; rights are revoked except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An archived document is reactivated, creating a new version with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a document.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by e-mail upon document release.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version is reviewed and released via a workflow, making it visible to readers.

evts.name: physical_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, a document is physically deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An Attachment belongs to and is controlled by a main Document.
Additional Information is supplementary to a Document without being part of its release cycle.
A Change Proposal belongs to and references a specific Document.
A Request For Validity Extension is linked to the Document whose validity is being checked.
A Request For Override is created for a specific Document to be invalidated.
A Request For Reactivation references the archived Document to be reactivated.
One or more Document Templates are defined per document type and selectable when creating a Document.
A Document can reference another Document (e.g. local extension referencing original in multi-client system).
A Document can be linked to a Process via the filing structure.
A Document can be linked to an Organizational Unit.
A Distribution List is maintained for a specific Document.
A User is assigned to one or more User Groups.
A Distribution List contains assigned User Groups.
A Distribution List can contain directly assigned Users (persons).
Electronic Signatures are applied by participants within a Workflow step.
